freshness.excludeEvidence: v3-v9 cannot be fresh primary or independent qualification evidence for any changed candidate informed by them.
requirements: Chosen candidate never executed on the frozen qualification bytes; no candidate outputs inspected.
Source/recording selection uses truth metadata and published provenance only, never candidate output or previous candidate-specific outcomes.
Freeze truth, exact original audio objects, deterministic PCM/source-rate preparation, synchronization, model input identities and all scenarios before first candidate execution.
Probe current and reachable deleted/renamed Git history plus local execution receipts by recording ID, source/audio/MIDI/PCM hashes and dataset identity. UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE is ineligible.
Keep license/research-purpose/primary-role authorization, training overlap, source pairing and model-output exposure as distinct gates; known license alone is insufficient.
Do not pool two source rates as independent physical performances.
No post-output replacement, target change, schedule change, scorer change or undeclared reserve selection.

foundationForFutureGeometryFreeze.adapter: production QualifiedSourceAdapter, pinned FIR and exact first source domain
foundationForFutureGeometryFreeze.planner: production window planner, not a copied formula
foundationForFutureGeometryFreeze.candidateGeometry: Freeze the eventual chosen candidate geometry first; any difference from this reference requires a new identity and recomputed pre-output feasibility, not a silent substitution.
foundationForFutureGeometryFreeze.executionClock: Use a prospectively declared source-capture chronology and publication scheduling contract. The v7 append/drain-barrier offline schedule can make endpoints uniquely reconstructable, but is not real-device UX latency evidence. If actual capture progresses during inference, instrument physical captured-through at delivery rather than infer it from window end.
foundationForFutureGeometryFreeze.warmReady: Stable capture domain plus real preroll and completed first full owned interval, then semantic READY. No nominal timeout; no moving selected physical events after execution.

busyFeasibility.name: ARCHITECTURE_DERIVED_BUSY_FEASIBILITY_BEFORE_ACOUSTIC_OUTPUT
busyFeasibility.P1_min: For each rate r, uniquely identify the half-open owned window containing original G1 source coordinate. P1_min(r) is the earliest exact source-block endpoint at which the production adapter has enough target frames for that window's complete real input and publication can become eligible. This is not event time, analysis frontier or wall-clock completion.
busyFeasibility.necessaryRule: G2 > P1_min(r) at BOTH rates, strictly. G2 << P1_min can never establish the intended physical-busy relation under the frozen append/drain schedule.
busyFeasibility.openingVsSealing: P1_min is a necessary availability lower bound, not proof an attempt opened or sealed. Compute a separate content-blind interval of possible sealing endpoints from candidate event-time contract and fixed gesture horizon, including next-window coverage where needed. Do not promise recognition from geometry.
busyFeasibility.futureHold: For design feasibility use a prospectively pinned 1000ms source-progress analysis hold and zero reset hold. A future executable protocol must confirm these exact units and lifecycle ownership before selecting sources; hold begins only at actual SEAL.
busyFeasibility.candidateEventTimingEnvelope: Before fresh source selection, declare a candidate source-event envelope justified independently on exposed development evidence. It may use the frozen <=100ms truth-attribution region as a conservative design envelope, not as an event-time rewrite or changed acceptance tolerance. If no content-blind bounded seal envelope can be justified, STOP before new qualification.
busyFeasibility.bounds: For each r, derive possible seal endpoints [S_earliest(r),S_latest(r)]. A conservative shared physical-busy interval is L=max_r(P1_min(r),S_latest(r)), U=min_r(S_earliest(r)+analysisHoldMs). Require L<U; otherwise that topology/geometry is prospectively infeasible.
busyFeasibility.noGuaranteeClaim: An intersection creates architecture-level opportunity, not an actual denominator. Unexpected early candidates, acoustic misses, crossing windows or runtime timing can still make a preselected trial NOT_EVALUABLE. Keep it; do not replace it.

BUSY_GAP_GRID.derivation: Architecture-relative grid, not a new acoustic parameter or H sweep. Let feasible source-time width W=U-L. Pre-register three disjoint bins (L,L+W/3), [L+W/3,L+2W/3), [L+2W/3,U), always excluding outer endpoints. Each bin is a fixed G2-G1 gap band after subtracting original G1 time.
BUSY_GAP_GRID.selection: In a separately authorized future metadata-only inventory, use frozen lexical recording order then original onset/gesture ID order to select naturally occurring physical pairs per bin. Never stretch audio, retime notes, select by predictions or use target-looking outputs.
BUSY_GAP_GRID.rateConstraint: One original performance occurrence must satisfy the shared interval and source preparation at both 44100/48000; no rate-specific replacement.
BUSY_GAP_GRID.preflightStop: If fresh local paired material cannot cover a predeclared mandatory bin/stratum/phase, report topology not established before inference. No dataset shopping or collection is authorized by v10.
BUSY_GAP_GRID.executionAcceptance: Record actual first attempt open/seal, G2 physical state and physical rearm. Every mandatory safety topology needs nonzero actual denominators at each rate. Preregister all cases and any aggregate coverage requirement before outputs; never retain only passing grid bins.

latePublicationDesign.openingPublication: Freeze W1 from G1 physical coordinate and owned geometry before outputs; it must be delivered normally and actually open Attempt A.
latePublicationDesign.secondPhysicalGesture: G2 must be strictly after actual Attempt A open and before its busy interval ends at BOTH rates, with original source identity unchanged.
latePublicationDesign.separatePublication: Require unique content-blind W2 containing G2; W2 must differ from W1 and must not be needed to open Attempt A or seal the active first-anchor gesture. Owned regions cannot assign both G1 and G2 to the same delayed opening publication.
latePublicationDesign.feasibilityChecks: Before execution, use the bounded seal interval and source-block endpoints to require G2 < earliest possible A rearm, W2 capture endpoint <= earliest rearm, and delayed W2 delivery > latest possible A rearm at both rates. Otherwise reject geometry before outputs, not after a model miss.
latePublicationDesign.delay: Predeclare 1000ms source-progress publication delay only if the above inequalities establish a shared nonempty feasible interval. If not, STOP for a separate design decision before source selection; do not silently increase delay.
latePublicationDesign.selector: Unique source-owned W2 identity only, never target pitch, confidence, MATCH-looking observations or publication contents.
latePublicationDesign.retirement: Actual rearm uses physical captured-through. The late event must be <= that retired watermark and delivery strictly after next READY. Check these facts in actual trace; geometry alone is not denominator=1.
latePublicationDesign.invalidCase: If W1 also carries G2, if A never opens, or if no prior retired rearm exists, retain NOT_EVALUABLE; no alternate window or case may be chosen after output.

denominators.safety: dangerous count=0 AND mandatory actual causal denominator>0 at BOTH rates; zero/zero never PASS
denominators.architectureEquality: Architecture-only boundary witness, never independent empirical safety evidence.
denominators.readiness: Each positive physical event must be strictly after actual READY eligibility. Metadata opportunity is not an actual denominator.
denominators.ambiguity: Tied/ambiguous physical attribution or unproven captured-through is NOT_EVALUABLE and blocks full qualification.
denominators.functional: All preregistered correct positive sequences must work on valid trials, independently of safety counts. Missing causal coverage and functional failure are coequal blockers, not hidden by disposition priority.

truthAndExecutionSeparation: Freeze one selected engineering candidate after exposed-development comparison, without calling it a scientific winner.
Prospectively select a wholly fresh source-disjoint paired corpus by metadata/provenance and geometry only.
Freeze exact truth/audio/PCM/scenarios/input hashes, denominator rules, fault selector and tooling; push and remote verify.
Fresh protected Continuous regression on the frozen stack is prerequisite, never an inherited PASS.
Audio-only blind acoustic execution with real pinned browser Worker/runtime; truth/targets/scenario correctness unavailable; seal outputs before truth evaluation.
Verify remote seal, then use actual product runtime and frozen scorer exactly once, without tuning or replacement.
Report independent safety, functional recognition, coverage, resources, timing clock domains and scientific/commercial/device limitations.
Stop for independent audit; microphone integration requires separate authorization.
